# ESP32-C6 open-path placement check, both passes on the board ending 2C:48: every image

rind's time for each image, in µs: the median over that image's flashes, with the number of flashes (n) and the spread (slowest − fastest flash) / fastest. A ratio is the image's median over the control's (`t275`); below 1 is faster than the control. `t275` was flashed 5 times; `t280` was flashed 3 times. An image flashed once has one run, so its spread is 0 and says nothing about repeatability; read it against the control's spread. The RustCrypto column is the median of every flash of every image (the same RustCrypto code in each image, a layout control). Every number here is recomputed from [ab-both-passes.json](ab-both-passes.json) by `cargo verify`.
All sessions pooled: same board, same images (by sha256), same order. `s1-N` is flash N of [5430e8b6c600941da22ba76df8334b6a5ec1ca44-open-placement-2026-11-23](../5430e8b6c600941da22ba76df8334b6a5ec1ca44-open-placement-2026-11-23/NOTES.md), and `s2-N` flash N of this tree. A flash is still one run.
